assumptions: A one-use key can still make its first cut on the wrong site. Faster indiscriminate trapping can destroy useful progression; stable sequestration is an alternative in the model rather than a demonstrated component. New source failures do not erase prior successful exposure or turn producer reports into ROOT governing reads. Per-event loss is distinct from per-cycle loss.
